response.sql: SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(UnitPrice) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Baseline is the average UnitPrice over all rows in Track (each track counted once), not weighted by sales in InvoiceLine.
Media types with no tracks are not shown since MediaTypeId is taken from Track grouping; ties in ratio have arbitrary order.
